card.title: More Power, More Problems
card.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three more departments to cover! My influence is spreading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll have a presence in every department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Put the department names on it; they'll see how far my jurisdiction extends.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 added departments mean influence, A3 borrowed rooms mean presence and A5 desk loss becomes mobile headquarters with jurisdiction labels.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 no budget and rooms causes A3 expanded-presence claim; B4 trolley and desk removal cause A5 mobile authority.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 communicate real resource restrictions and propose a practical file solution.

heightening.evidence: B4 loss of workspace is celebrated at A5 as visible reach across the very departments burdening A.

specificity.evidence: A1 departmental coverage and B2 resource shortage establish a concrete workload expansion.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 department names on a trolley transforms B4 practical displacement into a specific influence symbol.
